notes.note: Scoped final OAuth failure-lifecycle review. The per-account token envelope now conditionally records needs-sign-in after a failed refresh or repeated 401; fresh consent replaces that marker. Runtime, probe and proxy readers use the same provider, so failed refresh grants are not retried on later calls and account status no longer reports those tokens connected. Conditional marking preserves a concurrent winning token or disconnect. Reviewed this delta against the existing engine/account, issuer-binding and bespoke-route claims; automation, peer/device transport and Project authority are unchanged. EXECUTED: the repeated-refresh regression first failed with two token requests, then the four OAuth/runtime suites passed 131 tests. This is source/fixture evidence; live OAuth-provider, OS-kernel confinement and hosted acceptance remain NOT_VERIFIED.
